bull.b: Advancing AX-0811 into Phase 1 and achieving initial clinical validation for Axiomer demonstrate tangible progress beyond preclinical research. Multiple programs and planned data readouts could strengthen the platform’s credibility, support partnerships, and expand future development opportunities.

A substantial cash balance and runway extending into mid-2028 give ProQR time to generate clinical data across several programs without facing immediate financing pressure. This supports continued R&D investment and improves strategic flexibility while the pipeline advances.

The strong revenue rebound and very high gross margin indicate that collaboration and licensing-related activity can generate economically attractive revenue when recognized. If growth continues, this profile could provide greater support for research spending as programs mature.

bear.b: ProQR remains far from break-even despite improving revenue, with substantial net and operating losses continuing to absorb capital. Persistent unprofitability limits internally funded growth and leaves future financial performance highly dependent on successful development and partnering outcomes.

Meaningfully negative operating and free cash flow show that ProQR’s current activities consume cash rather than fund themselves. Continued burn can require additional financing or collaboration proceeds over time, potentially increasing dilution risk and constraining investment choices.

Because ProQR has no marketed commercial products, revenue depends on collaboration payments, licensing economics, milestones, royalties, financing, and cash on hand. This creates an uneven funding model in which financial support is tied to agreements and clinical progress rather than recurring product demand.
